name: nonExpiringApplicationKeysCount
definition: Number of the account's application keys that never expire.
population: the application keys the storage account lists (the master key is not listed)
evidenceRequiredForTrue: Not applicable: a count. A value is reported only from a complete key list (no further page) that lists at least one key.
citations: Backblaze B2 native API reference, b2_list_keys: https://www.backblaze.com/apidocs/b2-list-keys

changeLog.change: Registered with the Backblaze B2 transforms, its first implementation.

notes: Backblaze B2: expirationTimestamp null. The account's master application key is not returned by b2_list_keys.
